findings.notes: Low is supportable WITHOUT the manipulation leg, but only on a corrected rationale. Proven: a static 1.38 bps autoUSD redeem discount is minted as unbacked phUSD (V2 emits Antimatter => real dilution, not opportunity cost) on every USDC autoAnnihilate with no floor. That contradicts story-028's assumption that the direct-strategy top-up is rounding-scale (story tests at non-integral share price) - a genuine Law-2 premise failure on a live pool. However, the title/description misstate story-028: its slippageToleranceBps bound is explicitly scoped to ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy ('through an AMM-backed strategy', StableStakerV2.sol:496-497), and the qa-report quote elides those words. Required before submission: (1) reframe as 'story-028 assumes rounding-scale top-up for direct strategies; autoUSD delivers a non-rounding 1.38 bps shortfall with no floor', restore the elided quote; (2) move the manipulation step out of attackPath into escalationTrigger/flagForHuman only. With the proven impact being dust (~$2/full exit, reward-bounded), Low is the ceiling; QA would also be defensible.
